content.intro: This lesson introduces input validation and data sanitization as part of python security and reliability. It turns the curriculum heading into a short, practical concept guide with a visual, example, and checks to try locally.
content.why_it_matters: Security depends on clear trust boundaries. Validate input, keep secrets out of source control, use safe APIs, and follow the standard library documentation for risk areas.

content_blocks.title: Version and reliability note
content_blocks.text: Security-sensitive topics require explicit trust boundaries. Never use pickle for untrusted data, avoid shell command strings built from user input, and do not commit credentials.
